items.a: Telzyra is an independent workflow automation platform. You subscribe, connect the apps you use and build automations in a visual editor. Your workflows run on Telzyra's own execution engine.

Every workflow starts with a trigger, such as an incoming webhook, a schedule or an app event. Telzyra then runs the steps you defined in order, passes data from one step to the next and records the result of every run.
No. Workflows are built visually by connecting nodes and mapping fields. If you are technical, you can still use webhooks, HTTP requests and custom expressions for advanced cases.

Telzyra includes core building blocks such as webhooks, HTTP requests, schedules and conditional logic. App connectors are being released gradually, and the Integrations page shows the current status of each one.
Plans differ by monthly operations, active workflows, scheduling frequency and team size. You can start on the free plan and upgrade or downgrade at any time. Yearly billing includes two months free.
Telzyra is designed with security first. Data is encrypted in transit, connection credentials are encrypted at rest and stay inside your workspace, and you control how long execution history is kept.
